decisions.decision: toolagent is acquired and verified but excluded from every split
decisions.why: it is a relabeled copy of mooncake_trace (audit r1 F1); as a family hold-out it would test nothing new, and as train data it would duplicate Mooncake segments (pseudo-replication).

decisions.decision: FAST25 conversation_trace is a test-only held-out family; its windows align to Mooncake test windows w3, w6 (time x 3,536,999/3,600,000) and reuse their segment ids
decisions.why: different prefix structure (reuse 0.384 vs 0.630, one root) but a shared arrival/length skeleton, so it is not an independent segment (audit r1 F1 fix 3).

decisions.decision: FAST25 synthetic_trace (fetched at Mooncake commit 0d1a8040, no local copy existed) is a second test-only held-out family with two windows
decisions.why: independent of Mooncake and conversation (<= 8 shared (ISL, OSL) pairs, 0 shared (ts, ISL, OSL) rows); caveat: only 22 of 3,993 rows tie on arrival, so crn-order-v1 replicates are near-degenerate there and its noise must come from segments.

decisions.decision: synthetic sessions come from a seeded multi-turn Mooncake generator (10 seeds = 10 segments), not the native synthetic-session source
decisions.why: the native source cannot express a conversation through the Python API: constant ISL/OSL (LengthSpec stddev 0, lib/bindings/python/rust/llm/replay.rs:2292,2296), constant inter-turn delay (:2305), and later turns do not extend earlier context (aisimulate-core loadgen/trace.rs:845-852 draws fresh unique blocks per turn). Generated turns extend the full conversation, lengths are lognormal, think times exponential (completion-relative delay, causal per LR-09), arrivals Poisson floored to a 1 s grid so crn-order-v1 has ties to permute.

decisions.decision: every AgentX derived trace caps idle gaps at 300 s (think_cap_s), compressing longer idle gaps linearly to 300 s; the raw plays stay unchanged in traces/agentx/plays
decisions.why: selected plays contain idle gaps up to 355,532 s and spans up to 366,695 s (median 2,922 s; median busy 284 s; runs/build_workloads/out/agentx_idle_gaps.json); uncapped, all 82 plays at N=16, 16 lanes simulate 399,658,270 ms vs 11,942,325 ms capped (runs/build_workloads/smoke/cost.json), leaving lanes idle for days. 140 of 2,666 gaps (56 of 82 plays) exceed 300 s; capped, the median span is 1,265 s and the maximum 7,093 s. The AgentX scenario also caps idle delays. Side effect: distinct session ids 281 -> 278 (the importer splices chains across gaps <= 3600 s, weka.rs:27,1372).

decisions.decision: AgentX uses agentic_lanes only, and has no N=16/32 cells
decisions.why: timestamp mode starts every play at t=0 (audit r1 F3), so it is not an open-loop arrival process. With 82 unique plays split three ways, a subset of 7-22 plays cannot load 16-32 workers at >= 1 lane per worker with lanes < plays; recycling plays would replay the same workload.

decisions.decision: Mooncake: seven 12-minute slices, each 4 min warm-up + 8 min measurement ([4+8k, 12+8k) min); train w0,w2,w4; val w1,w5; test w3,w6
decisions.why: LR-01 warm-up before every open-loop window; ~4,250-5,020 requests per cell (1.0-2.2 s per replay in process, runs/build_workloads/smoke/cells_validation.json) while keeping 7 independent segments.

decisions.decision: prefix_root_mult keys families by the first block after each root's common segment, not by the first block
decisions.why: Mooncake has 4 distinct first blocks and conversation 1, so keying by the first block keeps each root whole and the transform is a relabeling with no effect. Caveat: the realized effect on Mooncake stays small (w2 root2: roots 4 -> 8, reuse 0.602 -> 0.601) because its root segments are 1-12 blocks.

decisions.decision: isl_prefix_mult scales blocks that occur in >= 2 requests (the union of every request's shared-with-earlier prefix); isl_unique_mult scales the per-request unique suffix
decisions.why: a block that is new in request A and reused by B must expand identically in both for hash identity to stay consistent; a per-request 'earlier' split cannot do that.

decisions.decision: context cap: drop Mooncake rows with ISL >= 131072 (replay rejects them for every policy) and clamp outputs to 131072 - ISL; Weka plays clamp outputs only
decisions.why: replay silently truncates ISL + OSL > 131072 (setup.json long_context.notes); counts are in each derived meta (e.g. islu2.5 on w3 drops 36 of 4,832 rows; FAST25 synthetic windows drop 3 and 9).

decisions.decision: test cells at N = 6 carry selection_exposed = true
decisions.why: CONTRACT puts N = 6 in validation and test; LESSONS plan delta (LR-10/LR-11) asks for the label if 6 stays in validation.

decisions.decision: cell measure carries only basis; measure_trace carries the trace-time warm-up and window
decisions.why: the harness's measure.warmup_ms/window_ms are replay milliseconds, which depend on the speedup calibration has not chosen; the harness rejects unknown measure keys (learned_routing/goodput.py:155).

interface_notes: cells use trace_files 'CR/...' (resolved by learned_routing.paths.Layout.resolve_path) and trace_sha256 = SHA-256 of the derived file, which learned_routing.cells.Cell.trace_content_sha checks; all 104 cells load with learned_routing.cells.load_cells, and replicates materialize for mooncake, sessions and weka cells

calibration must fill load.value, sla (itl_ms, e2e_slowdown) and, for open loop, measure.warmup_ms = measure_trace.warmup_ms / speedup and measure.window_ms = measure_trace.window_ms / speedup; for closed loop and lanes it fixes the steady-state rule

for session traces arrival_speedup_ratio also divides inter-turn delays (aisimulate-core loadgen/trace.rs speed_up_timing); to change load without changing think time, materialize think_mult = speedup with the transform tool
pyproject.toml lists packages = ['learned_routing']; a built wheel or sdist omits learned_routing.workloads unless packages use find or list the subpackage (editable install works)
unit tests live in learned_routing/workloads/tests (pytest testpaths is tests/, so run them by path or add the directory)
expected_cost_s is part of a cell's content SHA in learned_routing.cells (not in NON_CONTENT_KEYS), so re-estimating cost would change cache keys

applied.LR-01: warm-up slice before every open-loop window, arrival-basis measure windows (measure_trace)
applied.LR-02: every cell carries an independent workload segment id; 12 independent test segments, 7 validation
applied.LR-09: AgentX lanes only; session turns released by completion-relative delay; validation has >= 3 segments per load mode
applied.LR-11: segments as the unit of independence; FAST25 conversation shares Mooncake segment ids; toolagent excluded
applied.LR-12: per-cell cache-pressure numerator table (distinct block tokens per trace window) for calibration; Mooncake-format train traces span prefix reuse 0.555-0.844

rejected.LR-03, LR-04, LR-05, LR-06, LR-07, LR-13: out of scope for workloads (policy, harness, training or audit stages)
rejected.LR-08: superseded by Amendment A2 (no TTFT SLO); ISL buckets are a reporting concern

selection.predicate: every normal/streaming request, recursively including subagents, satisfies in + max(out, 1) <= 131072; whole play kept unchanged
